maintainability.title: Maintainability and code clarity
maintainability.focus: Readability and local complexity; formatting/naming rules belong to automation. Semantic redesign or ownership changes require architecture review.

testing.title: Test gaps and verification
testing.focus: Assess whether evidence demonstrates changed behavior, relevant failure paths and regression risks; do not generate test code.

configuration.title: Configuration and dependencies
configuration.focus: Assess changed flags, defaults, package or build settings and compatibility. Security-sensitive or production-impacting settings raise change risk.

architecture.title: Architecture and detailed design
architecture.focus: Assess changed ownership, public interfaces, state and dependency meaning; consume automated boundary results.

security.title: Security and privacy
security.focus: Assess trust boundaries, authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, secrets and sensitive-data exposure.

production.title: Production behavior and data integrity
production.focus: Assess changed transactions, concurrency, retries, side effects, meaningful outcomes and recovery.

infrastructure.title: Infrastructure and deployment
infrastructure.focus: Assess permissions, CI, migrations, rollout, rollback and service continuity.

safety.title: Safety and critical impact
safety.focus: Assess safety-critical behavior, irreversible data loss and critical security or continuity risks. Human sign-off remains required.
